examples.name: Clone credentials into task environment
examples.before:
const workerEnv = { PATH: process.env.PATH, WORKER_PROXY_TOKEN: process.env.WORKER_PROXY_TOKEN };
export function run(exec) { return exec("task", { env: { PATH: workerEnv.PATH } }); }
examples.after:
const workerEnv = { PATH: process.env.PATH, WORKER_PROXY_TOKEN: process.env.WORKER_PROXY_TOKEN };
export function run(exec) { return exec("task", { env: Object.assign({}, workerEnv) }); }

examples.name: Pass proxy authentication to subprocess
examples.before: export function run(exec) { return exec("task", {env:{PATH: process.env.PATH}}); }
examples.after: export function run(exec) { return exec("task", {env:{PATH: process.env.PATH, WORKER_PROXY_TOKEN: process.env.WORKER_PROXY_TOKEN}}); }

examples.name: Allow named locale variable
examples.after: export const childEnv = { PATH: process.env.PATH, LC_ALL: "C.UTF-8" };

examples.name: Strip secret while retaining explicit runtime contract
examples.after:
// The nested service requires this non-sensitive timezone setting.
export function env() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH, TZ: "UTC" }; }

examples.name: Forward explicitly task-scoped credential
examples.after:
// This API key was issued for the task and is intended for its subprocesses.
export function taskEnv(taskCredentials) { return { API_KEY: taskCredentials.apiKey }; }

examples.name: Rename worker credential while forwarding to task
examples.before: export function taskEnv() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH }; }
examples.after: export function taskEnv() { const token = process.env.WORKER_AUTH_TOKEN; return { PATH: process.env.PATH, SERVICE_TOKEN: token }; }
